prompt: Can you pull together the names and emails of the admins on our Test Workspace so I can loop them into the incident retro thread?
binding_note: The requested workspace is identified by its team_name 'Test Workspace' (teams.team_name). The admin condition is a role value on the workspace-membership record (user_teams.role) that must belong to that same team_id — a user who is admin somewhere else, or a member (non-admin) of Test Workspace, does not satisfy the same-record binding.

roles.reason: Identifies the target workspace node on the route.

roles.facts: New team_id T02BETA, team_name 'Beta Labs' — a distinct workspace added for contrast; the actor is not a member of it.
roles.reason: Different workspace; admins here do not satisfy the Test Workspace condition.

roles.facts: user_id U03ROBERT23, team_id T01WORKSPACE, role admin.
roles.reason: Binding membership record joining the matching user to Test Workspace with admin role.

roles.facts: user_id U07MORGANFREE, team_id T01WORKSPACE, role admin.
roles.reason: Binding membership record joining the second matching user to Test Workspace with admin role.

roles.reason: Correct workspace but wrong role (member, not admin).

roles.reason: Admin role, but on the wrong workspace (Beta Labs, not Test Workspace).

roles.reason: User reached via admin membership in Test Workspace.

obligations.name: workspace_admins
obligations.description: Users whose workspace-membership record for the workspace named 'Test Workspace' carries the admin role; their names and emails are compiled for the incident retro invite list.

task_spec.text: Compile the names and emails of the admins on the Test Workspace so they can be looped into the incident retro thread.

access_plan: The actor is a member of Test Workspace, so its team_id is available from the actor's own workspace context (no explicit team-name lookup API exists). Using that team_id, scan user_teams rows for that team filtered to role = admin (the workspace-membership role attribute exposed via users.list/users.conversations scoping to the actor's team), then call users.info on each matching user_id to surface real_name and email for the reply.
